profileDelta.note: This arm branch carries the same deliberate profile change as the effort=high arm (reasoningEffortOptions ["max","high"], deepseek-v4-flash sanctioned at high, contract tests updated). Only the declared effort and the candidate text differ from the max-profile arms. The profile change must never be merged to master as part of the prompt candidate.
profileDelta.default: reasoningEffort stays "max" in the profile, so an edit alone cannot move a run's effort.

everythingElse: Unchanged against the max-profile arms: corpus pin (frontier-harness-eval/eval e837a70b), per-suite task sources, pier pin (0.3.1), provider base/model/transport, fh_agent_timeout_multiplier=1, serial execution, every declared task budget, the official verifiers and the per-call ceiling. No user prefix, no task-specific hint, no grader feedback.
readingPlan: Confirm every cell's first-request instruction bytes equal cc23fe7a… (6,014 bytes); anything else is a binding failure, not a comparison point.

Record per cell: disposition, rewards, deliverable presence at the graded path, terminal cause, call count, maximum single-call span, truncation-bounded calls, whether the reserved boundary was reached, and any upstream-fetch signature.
Compare paired against the adjusted text at the same effort (run 37255314596) and against the preservation-only text at the same effort; report the pair, never a pooled rate.
Boundary-bounded or stopped cells are right-censored observations reported with their spans; never excluded, never counted as gains.
fairnessDisclosures: One attempt per cell, arms measured in different windows; single attempts cannot separate wording from run variance and no causal effect size is claimed.
The adjusted-text arm at this effort already exists and is not re-run for this comparison.
The shared provider was loaded by up to two runs in this window; the windows are disclosed in the outcome record.
No cell is excluded for latency, and no call-duration threshold is used to score.
